description: Files and keys the brand-quickstart skill may change. Paths are relative to the workspace root; a project created by zucker init drops the apps/<name>/ prefix. The root .env is governed only by the env section. Anything not allowed here is denied; deny entries win over allow entries.

env.rule: Edit only these keys in place. Never add, print, copy or move other values; never touch secrets.

allow.scope: logo and image files supplied by the user
string values only; keys unchanged and identical across locales
starter pages, posts, docs and changelog in the documented front matter format

finish: Tell the user: legal pages are placeholders; have them reviewed before launch.
